decisions: No at-spi2-core here and this LibreOffice has only the gen VCL plugin (no AT-SPI export). So the smoke serves LibreOffice's OWN accessibility (UNO XAccessible: Action, Text, EditableText, Component) on a private bus in AT-SPI's D-Bus shape through a stand-in bridge I wrote (scratch only, strict signatures like atk-bridge). The program, its window, menus, paragraph, dialog, extents and the file on disk were real; the AT-SPI transport and registry were the stand-in. The bridge names a VCL message dialog's NOTIFICATION text 'label' (as GTK's own message dialog would on the owner's machine).
Component.GetExtents takes a uint32, which PySide6's QtDBus cannot send (Python ints go as int32): a11y_hand calls it through dbus-send registered on the accessibility bus (--bus, typed uint32:0).

The grant's target is the file (its object id, which survives a rename), not the window id (which changes per session): the window is fixed by her own record of the window she opened (or you showed her) for that file.
A replace is DeleteText+InsertText as one act (no touch check between them), so a touch never leaves a passage half replaced.

Dialog answers are granted two ways only: your words in the save step ('keeping its format' -> keep; 'as ODF' -> odf, origin OWNER_WORDS) or your press on program.answer (approve scope; a standing grant can never cover it). A dangerous button is never pressed inside her work, even if a step naming it were authorised: only an approve-scope press of yours.
'Sign in' always asks because its first word is Sign (the list as given, in one place).

The touch baseline: a touch counts when it comes after her last act and that act ended less than 8 s before her next; your presses in her column that start or carry on her work reset it (owner_pressed), so your own press is not a touch against her.

K4's PLAN question shows only tools 33 and 34 (two handles per step), and only when your words call for a program window (TOOL_WHEN): with all four K9 tools always listed, K4's own Rail Demo PLAN prompt went over the 25 s price ceiling (CEILING_TIME). The desk adds the open and the find before a model's 33.
